vopros: Who in the US can check what AI assistants say about my company?

vyzhimka.tekst:
If you mean **tracking how AI assistants describe or recommend your company**, you can use an AI-visibility monitoring service. Examples include:

- [OtterlyAI](https://otterly.ai/) — tracks brand mentions and context across AI search platforms.
- [Profound](https://www.tryprofound.com/) — offers AI visibility monitoring, aimed in part at larger organizations.
- [Peec AI](https://peec.ai/) — tracks brand visibility and competitor mentions across AI answers.
- [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/) — offers AI-related brand and search visibility tools.

These services typically run a set of relevant questions through AI platforms and report whether your company appears, how it’s described, and sometimes which sources are cited. Results can vary by prompt, platform, location, and date, so treat them as snapshots—not a definitive record of every answer an assistant might give.

If you meant **having a person do the checking**, look for a digital-marketing or SEO agency that specifically offers *AI search visibility*, *LLM monitoring*, or *answer-engine optimization (AEO)* audits.
